A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Still curious? Let's talk ↗

Can I try TaskFlow for free?

Starter is the free concept tier. This demo previews onboarding without creating an account.

Do I need a credit card?

No. The local trial preview asks for a workspace name and email only. Nothing is transmitted.

Can I bring my existing projects?

The product concept supports migration. This static page does not import projects or connect external services.

Can I change my plan later?

Real billing is not connected here. Use the monthly/yearly selector to compare illustrative Pro prices.

How is my team's data protected?

The demo uses your browser's local storage for a workspace label only. Enterprise security features are product concepts, not implemented services.
